Plot derived vs traditional coverage over time

Source: R/plot.derived_coverage.R
plot.cd_derived_coverage.Rd

Generates a line plot comparing traditional (coverage_old) and derived (coverage_new) coverage estimates over time for a single indicator. It supports both national and subnational views.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'cd_derived_coverage'
plot(
  x,
  type = c("bar", "trend"),
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  caption = NULL,
  x_title = NULL,
  y_title = NULL,
  legend_title = NULL,
  ...,
  legend_labels = list(),
  options = NULL
)

Arguments

x

A cd_derived_coverage object.

type

A character string specifying the plot type: "bar" or "trend". "trend" can only be applied nationally or to a specific region. Defaults to "bar".

title

The chart's title.

subtitle

The line under the title.

caption

The note under the chart.

x_title

The title of the horizontal axis.

y_title

The title of the vertical axis.

legend_title

The title of the legend.

...

Chart options by name (see cd_chart_options()): background, fonts, sizes, axes, grid, legend, colours. Other arguments are ignored.

legend_labels

(Optional) A named list of character strings to override specific default legend labels (e.g., list(penta1derived = "Custom Penta1")).

options

A cd_chart_options() object or a list of chart options: a look made once, to give to several charts. Applied after the text arguments, so a text it holds wins over them.

Value

A ggplot object showing coverage trends over time.

Examples

cache <- load_cache_data(system.file("extdata", "kenya.xlsx", package = "cd2030.core"))
#> ℹ Loading Excel "kenya.xlsx" for parts
#> ! The following columns are empty: anc_1trimester, under5_deaths, total_deaths,
#>   ipv2, measles_cases
#> ℹ Successfully loaded and cleaned data
#> ℹ Auto-detect candidates (|group|): vaccine=19, rmncah=28 -> selected rmncah
cache$set_national_estimates(list(sbr = 0.02))
cache$adjust_data()
derived <- cache$calculate_derived_coverage("penta3", "national")

plot(derived)

plot(derived, type = "trend", title = "Penta3: usual and derived denominators",
     y_title = "Coverage (%)", legend_position = "bottom")
